Guild.title: Guild
Guild.description: Represents a distinct guild or community within the platform.

name.description: The public, non-unique name of the guild.

baseHandle.description: A URL-friendly, slugified version of the name.

tagNumber.description: The user-chosen number for the guild's public tag.

publicTag.description: The unique, public-facing identifier for the guild (e.g., 'guild-name#007').

primaryGame.description: The primary game the guild is focused on.

visibility.description: Controls the guild's visibility in public directories.

createdAt.description: Timestamp of when the guild was created.

createdBy.description: The UID of the user who created the guild.

leaderUid.description: The UID of the player who leads the guild.

inviteCode.description: A unique, shareable code for joining the guild.

GuildDirectory.title: GuildDirectory
GuildDirectory.description: A global registry for fast, unique lookups of guild public tags.

guildId.description: The internal Firestore ID of the guild.

publicTag.description: The document ID, matching the public tag.

GuildMember.title: GuildMember
GuildMember.description: Links a user to a guild and defines their role.

Player.title: Player
Player.description: Represents a player's profile within a specific guild.

id.description: Unique identifier for the player entity, typically the same as the Firebase Auth UID.

guildId.description: The ID of the guild this player profile belongs to.

displayNameHistory.description: A log of the player's previous display names and when they were changed.

role.description: The player's role within the guild.

rank.description: The player's rank within the guild, based on honor.

friendIds.description: References to other Players who are friends. (Relationship: Player N:N Player)

isOnline.description: Indicates whether the player is currently online.

maxHonor.description: The maximum honor points the player has ever held.

recruitedBy.description: The ID of the player who recruited this player.

recruitedPlayers.description: A list of IDs of players recruited by this player.

avatarUrl.description: URL to the player's custom avatar image.

joinedAt.description: Timestamp of when the player joined the guild.

reportsSubmitted.description: Total number of run reports submitted by the player.

Character.title: Character
Character.description: Represents a character within the Dark and Darker Guild Hub.

id.description: Unique identifier for the character entity.

playerId.description: Reference to the Player that owns this character. (Relationship: Player 1:N Character)

guildId.description: The ID of the guild this character belongs to, denormalized for security rules.

totalBossKills.description: Total number of boss kills for this character.

confirmedKills.description: Number of kills confirmed by a verified run report.

unconfirmedKills.description: Number of kills from unverified run reports.

RunReport.title: RunReport
RunReport.description: Represents a run report submitted by a player.

id.description: Unique identifier for the run report entity.

reporterId.description: The ID of the player who submitted the report.

guildId.description: The ID of the guild this report belongs to.

runId.description: Reference to the Run this report is for.

map.description: The map the run took place on.

overallRunRating.description: Overall rating of the run from 1 to 10.

bossesKilled.description: Array of boss names killed during the run.

runNotes.description: Optional general notes about the run, visible to all teammates.

teammates.description: An array containing the stats and feedback for each participant in the run.

screenshotUrl.description: URL of the screenshot uploaded for scoreboard proof.

isConfirmed.description: Indicates if the stats have been confirmed by an officer.

officerNotes.description: Private notes about the run, visible only to officers.

requestMeeting.description: Indicates if the player wants to discuss this report with an officer.

evidenceLinks.description: An array of URLs to videos or other evidence.

Run.title: Run
Run.description: Represents a single run in the Dark and Darker Guild Hub.

id.description: Unique identifier for the run entity.

timestamp.description: Timestamp of when the run occurred.

BountyBoardQuest.title: BountyBoardQuest
BountyBoardQuest.description: Represents a daily or weekly quest available on the bounty board.

questName.description: Name of the bounty board quest.

questDescription.description: Description of the bounty board quest.

reward.description: Honor point reward for completing the quest.

rarity.description: The rarity or tier of the quest.

durationDays.description: How many days the quest is active for.

isRepeatable.description: Whether the same player can complete this quest multiple times.

maxCompletions.description: The maximum number of times this quest can be completed in total by all players. 0 for infinite.

requiredRank.description: The minimum player rank required to accept this quest.

HonorPointLog.title: HonorPointLog
HonorPointLog.description: Represents a log of honor point awards or deductions.

id.description: Unique identifier for the honor point log entity.

playerId.description: Reference to the Player associated with this log entry. (Relationship: Player 1:N HonorPointLog)

amount.description: The amount of honor points awarded or deducted (negative for deductions).

reason.description: The reason for the honor point change.

timestamp.description: Timestamp of when the honor point change occurred.

officerNotes.description: Notes that are written by officers when adjusting a score.

GuildBankItem.title: GuildBankItem
GuildBankItem.description: Represent an item available in the guild bank.

id.description: Unique identifier for the guild bank item.

description.description: Description of the item and its benefits.

price.description: Cost in honor points to purchase the item.

quantity.description: Quantity of this item that is available.

category.description: Category of the item (e.g., Utility, Consumable, Cosmetic).

requiredRank.description: The minimum player rank required to purchase this item.

RunReview.title: RunReview
RunReview.description: Reviews of other characters in a run.

id.description: Unique identifier of the run review.

runReportId.description: Reference to run report that this review is for. (Relationship RunReport 1:N RunReview)

reviewerCharacterId.description: Reference to the character completing the review. (Relationship Character 1:N RunReview)

reviewedCharacterId.description: Reference to the character being reviewed. (Relationship Character 1:N RunReview)

score.description: The score given to the character. Can range from 1-10

Application.title: Application
Application.description: Represents a guild membership application, submitted by a user.

userId.description: The auth ID of the user submitting the application.

guildId.description: The ID of the guild the user is applying to.

applicantName.description: The applicant's chosen name or handle.

inGameName.description: The applicant's Dark and Darker account name.

status.description: The current status of the application.

createdAt.description: Timestamp of when the application was submitted.

attemptCount.description: How many times this user has applied.

reviewHistory.description: A log of reviews and status changes from officers.

mainRoles.description: The applicant's main role(s) (e.g., Frontline, Support, DPS).

hoursInGame.description: Approximate number of hours the applicant has played.

bossesKilled.description: A list of bosses the applicant has defeated.

memorableExperience.description: A fun or memorable in-game experience.

isContentCreator.description: Whether the applicant is a content creator.

otherUrl.description: The applicant's other content platform URL.

availabilityDays.description: The days of the week the applicant typically plays.

availabilityStart.description: The typical start time of their play session (in their local timezone).

availabilityEnd.description: The typical end time of their play session (in their local timezone).

guildExpectations.description: What the applicant is looking to gain from and add to the guild.

references.description: Guild members who can vouch for the applicant.

GuildSettings.title: GuildSettings
GuildSettings.description: Global settings for a specific guild, managed by its officers. This document serves as the configuration hub for a single tenant (guild) in the multi-tenant system.

guildName.description: The public name of the guild.

guildSubtitle.description: A short tagline or motto for the guild.

traitOptions.description: A list of admin-defined feedback traits for run reports.

MemberBounty.title: MemberBounty
MemberBounty.description: A bounty posted by a guild member for other members to complete.

requestingPlayerId.description: The ID of the player who posted the bounty.

requestingPlayerName.description: The name of the player who posted the bounty.

acceptedPlayerId.description: The ID of the player who accepted the bounty.

acceptedPlayerName.description: The name of the player who accepted the bounty.

description.description: A detailed description of the bounty's requirements.

reward.description: The Honor Point reward for completing the bounty.

status.description: The current status of the bounty.

createdAt.description: Timestamp of when the bounty was created.

completedAt.description: Timestamp of when the bounty was completed.

definition.description: Stores high-level information about each individual guild.
A global registry for fast, unique lookups of guild public tags. The document ID is the publicTag.
Links a user to a guild and defines their role. The document ID is a composite key: {guildId}_{uid}.
Stores player information. Player ID is used for document ID. The 'guildId' field is critical for data segregation in this multi-tenant application.
Stores character information for each player. This collection is nested under a user's private data path, ensuring only they can manage their characters.
Stores run reports. This data is specific to a guild and will be secured via rules that check the submitting user's guildId.
Stores run information, used in conjunction with RunReport. This data is guild-specific.
Stores bounty board quests for a specific guild. Data access will be controlled by the user's guild membership.
Stores private honor point logs for each player, nested under their user document for security.
Stores guild bank items. Data access will be controlled by the user's guild membership.
Stores reviews for other characters in a run. This data is guild-specific.
Stores guild applications. This collection is readable by officers and the applicant.
A singleton document containing global settings for the guild. Publicly readable but only writable by officers/admins. In a multi-tenant system, this would be '/guilds/{guildId}/settings'.
A bounty posted by a guild member for others in the same guild to complete.

firestore.reasoning:
This Firestore structure is designed for a multi-tenant application where each 'tenant' is a distinct guild. The cornerstone of this architecture is data segregation, primarily achieved by using a 'guildId' on top-level documents and enforcing access via Firestore Security Rules. This ensures that users from one guild cannot access data from another.

**Multi-Tenancy and Data Segregation:**  The `guildId` field on documents like `/players/{playerId}` is critical. Security rules leverage this field by comparing it against a `guildId` stored in the user's authentication token (custom claim). This allows for secure `list` queries, for instance, allowing a user to list all players *only* within their own guild.

**Authorization Independence (Denormalization):** Authorization data (like `playerId` in sub-collections or `guildId` in root collections) is denormalized to avoid costly and complex `get()` calls in security rules. This simplifies rule logic and improves performance.

**Structural Segregation (Homogeneous Security Posture):** Collections are organized by their access patterns. User-private data (e.g., `/users/{userId}/characters`) is nested for ownership-based security. Guild-wide data (e.g., `/bounty_board_quests`) is stored at the root, with security rules ensuring only members of the correct guild can access it. This separation makes rules more predictable and maintainable.

**Access Modeling:** Access is consistently modeled. User-owned data is secured by path (`/users/{userId}`). Guild-level data is secured by checking the `guildId` in the user's token against the document's `guildId`. Role-based access (like for officers and admins) is managed by checking for the existence of a document in a corresponding `roles_*` collection.
